# Compify

> Package selected React component source into reviewable shadcn registry
> artifacts, using Storybook CSF as the explicit selection boundary.

Storybook remains upstream for authoring, tests, and documentation. Compify
statically inspects supported React CSF source; it does not execute stories or
promise runtime, visual, behavioral, or accessibility fidelity.

## Source-candidate workflow

The Storybook commands are present in the current repository source/release
candidate. The older npm CLI is 0.1.0; do not assume the source candidate has
been published unless a release announcement says so.

- Inspect one selected CSF boundary:
  `compify storybook inspect src/components/Button.stories.tsx --story Primary`
- Export deterministic registry JSON for review:
  `compify storybook export src/components/Button.stories.tsx --story Primary --output .compify/button.registry.json`
- Verify the local artifact with the pinned client used by this repository:
  `bunx shadcn@4.16.2 add .compify/button.registry.json`

See https://compify.app/docs/storybook and the exact evidence matrix at
https://compify.app/docs/compatibility.

## Configured registry installation

A configured Compify API can serve reviewed registry items. A namespace is not
built into shadcn: add the deployment to the target project's `components.json`:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@compify": "https://registry.example.com/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Then install an available item with the pinned client:
`bunx shadcn@4.16.2 add @compify/<name>`

Use the origin of the Compify API you operate. Private items require the Bearer
header configuration documented at https://compify.app/docs/registry. The
official Storybook tools provide upstream context, and official shadcn tooling
owns downstream installation semantics.

- Storybook translation: https://compify.app/docs/storybook
- Registry and namespace configuration: https://compify.app/docs/registry
